summary: Rocky Mountain Chocolate Factory filed an 8-K announcing the appointment of David Denker as Chief Operating Officer, effective August 14, 2026, with an amended employment agreement providing an annual base salary of $185,000. Denker previously served as VP of Franchise Development and has extensive franchise operations experience. This is a routine executive appointment, not a forced departure or special situation. The filing includes standard biographical details and confirms no family relationships or related-party transactions. As a routine officer appointment, this does not constitute a special-situation event; category is Management Changes with low confidence due to routine nature. No deal terms apply.
